messages:
tess: quick follow-up after the AM spike postmortem. root cause: two things -- bursty ramp + simultaneous scale-to-zero on spare nodes. want to lock down short-term SLO/SLA changes and owners.

andre: agree. propose a short mitigation package: 1) temp SLO window (06:00-09:00 UTC) with relaxed p95 by +20% 2) introduce a capacity-guardrail to prevent scale-to-zero during ramp 3) add early-warning non-pager alerts. i'll own the SLO wording.

lucy: i'll do dashboards and alerts. plan: add a 5m vs 1h p95 comparison, a per-pool "reservations" gauge, and an "error budget remaining" panel. alerts: early-warning -> slack; paging only after 30m sustained or error budget <15%.

hamid: infra will add a 10m scale-down lock after any >50% traffic increase to stop thrash. i'll own the patch and tests. target: feature branch + e2e by 2026-04-01.

alerts-bot: Incident 2026-03-30-07 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-30-ramp-spike. Action items attached.

tess: action items (short):
- SLO temporary window change (p95 +20% between 06:00-09:00 UTC for 2w): owner andre; due 2026-04-03.
- Dashboard + alert edits (early-warning non-pager + panels): owner lucy; due 2026-04-02.
- Scale-down lock (10m after big ramp): owner hamid; due 2026-04-05.
- Recurrence analysis (60/90 day): owner tess; due 2026-04-06.

andre: sample SLO diff i'll post in docs repo. wording note: make it explicit that the relax only applies to evaluation window, not to SLA commitments for enterprise tenants.

lucy: draft PromQL i'll add to PR: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and `sum(redwood_queue_length)`. will attach Grafana JSON.

hamid: infra note: we'll gate the scale-down lock behind a feature flag so we can roll back quickly if it changes capacity economics. tests will simulate ramp events.

tess: scheduling a 15min check-in 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC to review PRs/dashboards. please ping here when ready. :calendar:

lucy: ack, will ping with dashboard link.

andre: ack, will link SLO PR.

hamid: ack, feature branch soon.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window conflict detected on 2026-04-02 14:30 UTC for pool-east-1. Please verify before rollouts.
